answer: A fresh key is a hollow identity: it sails into the harbor expecting weight and finds none. In PoA, standing comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts sealed on-ledger and re-checked against consensus — a record no clone can be handed, bought, or minted, as hard to counterfeit as a raven's own call. A sybil swarm of M fakes must each grade its own way up from zero across many epochs; the cost scales linearly in identities, so the farm never shares one warmed credential.
